name: Shiori
message: "She's usually around here, but..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She doesn't seem to be here. I suppose things won't be that easy."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And we don't even know whether she's connected to the incident. We should go to another location first."

name: Shiori
message: "I agree. Let's go."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A woman who was involved in an abduction case in the past... Given that she's a candidate for Girl A, I'd very much like to speak with her."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Shall we leave for now? We can come back once we've taken care of our other tasks."

name: Shiori
message: "...Looks like she's not here."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It seems we've no choice but to come back later."

name: Shiori
message: "There she is. That's her."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see... From a distance, she looks like an ordinary mother you would find anywhere. But on closer inspection, the stroller is actually carrying a doll..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Part of me wants to ask her about the serial kidnapping murders, since we might obtain unexpected information, but..."

name: Shiori
message: "Since it involves children, it wouldn't be right to ask her... considering what she's been through."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Agreed. Let us only ask her about Kirishiki Nagisa-san, and show her the photo."

name: Shiori
message: "That should be... Uribayashi Rina-san, right?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A woman pushing a stroller with a baby doll in it... She can see ghosts, but she can't hear them..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "There are two points we want to clarify: when the abduction incident occurred, and whether it's connected to the serial kidnapping murders. However..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It's not something we should be asking her directly, especially considering the scars she's carrying."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. Let's just ask her about Kirishiki-san."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "While the chances are slim, if she does know something, it could be our lucky break. We have to do what we can."

name: Shiori
message: "It's true she can't hear us, but we'll back you up all the way."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Now then, let us try talking to her."
"Hello."

name: Rina
message: "Oh, hello. Look Micchan, your friends came to visit you again~"

name: Rina
message: "Come now, Micchan, say hello. Hello~"
"Hello, Micchan."

name: Rina
message: "Eheh~, look at that smile. Thank you again, for always coming to see Micchan."
"There's something I want to ask..."

name: Rina
message: "Hm? What is it?"
(Show her the photo)

name: Rina
message: "A photo? On your phone? You want me to look at it?"

name: Rina
message: "How nostalgic... That's Kirishiki-senpai, isn't it?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I'm surprised. It was a long shot, but I suppose it was worth trying."
"Do you know her?"

name: Rina
message: "Yes. She was my senior in high school. We were in the brass band together."

name: Rina
message: "I've always admired her, though it was just from the sidelines. I don't think she even knew who I was, eheh~"

name: Rina
message: "So why show me this photo? Is there something you want to ask about her?"
"We're looking for her..."

name: Rina
message: "I don't really know the details, but, um, you see, quite a while ago, Kirishiki-senpai committ—"

name: Rina
message:
"......
She died in an accident."

name: Rina
message: "That's why, err... she's no longer with us..."
"Thank you."

name: Rina
message: "I'm sorry I couldn't be of more help. If you don't mind, I'd love it if you'd come see Micchan again sometime."

name: Rina
message: "See you again~"

name: Shiori
message: "Good job back there. It really was worth asking her."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "With that, we now know that the woman in the flower garden was indeed Kirishiki Nagisa-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Which also means Gyaruko-san isn't Kirishiki Nagisa..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "But we still don't know whether she was simply mistaken, or deliberately lying."

name: Shiori
message: "If she was Kirishiki-san's junior... then age-wise, wouldn't she be a candidate for Girl A...?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes. And if we assume she was coerced into the kidnappings, which led to her mental breakdown..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No, pardon me. Please forget what I said. That was an utterly vulgar suspicion."

name: Shiori
message: "Even if she was involved, it's not like we have any way to confirm it."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Let us simply keep that possibility in mind, then."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "It is still too early to narrow down the suspects. But even so, confirming Kirishiki-san's identity is a significant breakthrough."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes. Shall we go and continue our investigation?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The fact that she is the most likely candidate for Girl A, the accomplice who carried out the kidnapping, has not changed."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Even I recoiled when I saw the doll laid down in the stroller. There is no doubt that she is deeply unwell."

name: Shiori
message: "...But aside from that, she's just a kind mother—an ordinary woman you could find anywhere."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She was about to say suicide, but then softened her words. It shows she has a degree of thoughtfulness."

name: Shiori
message: "Would someone like that really help someone harm children?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Indeed, it doesn't sit right."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Even so, we cannot afford to judge based on impressions alone."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Shall we look into her a little more closely?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "A mother pushing a stroller with a doll inside. Cruel as it is, it would certainly draw attention."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "In that case, there's no way a journalist investigating this area would have overlooked it."

name: Shiori
message: "By journalist... do you mean Tetsuya-san?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes. It isn't wise to rule out possibilities before even asking. I understand that quite well now."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "He may know something about the abduction case."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I hope he's still at the library. Though chances are he might have already gone home..."

name: Shiori
message: "Let's go and see. I'm sure your ties will guide us."
